note: 目前最新的版本與各版的更新內容。模組會在啟動時讀線上這一份（跟譯文同一套來源），所以發了新版只要改這個檔，玩家進遊戲就會看到提示——不必等他們自己去逛下載頁。同一份也打包進 jar，斷網時 F6 的『本版更新內容』照樣看得到。notes 的每一版預設寫英文；要哪一種語言另一套說法，就在那一版底下加一個語言代碼的物件（見 0.1.1 的 zh_tw / zh_cn）。latest 必須跟 gradle.properties 的 mod_version 一致，validate 會檢查。

1.0.3.headline: 1.0.3: other players' names in broadcasts, a Wynntils speed-up, and the Wynnventory price box
items: New: broadcasts that name another player are translated, with the name left as it is: party buffs, death messages and bombs.
New: world event start notices, shop countdown boards, NPC lines that arrive in chat and reward rows without an icon are translated.
New: the login welcome banner is translated line by line and keeps its colours.
New: dialogue lines too long for the box scroll like a marquee instead of showing the original.
New: F6 "Badge & cape" is now "Features", with a "Speed up Wynntils item rendering" switch (on by default) that makes the inventory, bank and market smoother.

New: with Wynnventory, the price box is placed by the tooltip that is actually shown, shrinks when it is too long, and with "anchor tooltips" on it stays at the left edge while the item tooltip moves clear of it. It also costs less while hovering an item.
Fixed: party buff broadcasts keep their colours (your name no longer turns yellow).
Fixed: player names in the Tab player list are no longer translated.
Fixed: translated scoreboard rows that are wider than the scoreboard wrap instead of running off it.
Fixed: the possible items list of an unidentified item shows the original names and keeps its indent, and the sealed description is centred again.
Fixed: item names from the item files show the original on the name rows, and possessive item names are no longer read as someone else's item.
Fixed: in the original + translation chat mode, messages that could not be translated are no longer posted again.
Fixed: Shiny item names are no longer reflowed with the badge row, and an opening bracket never ends a line.
Fixed: the side translation panel no longer covers the original tooltip.
Fixed: long dialogue wraps inside the panel, and replace mode no longer shows line break marks.
New: the Lootrun mission Balancing Act follows the content name setting.
Translations: Traditional Chinese quest dialogue polished across about 100 quests, unified terms, Lootrun panels and cards, Mythic names, and many more lines recorded in game.

1.0.2_2.headline: 1.0.2_2: fixes for floating text, nameplates and quest dialogue
items: Fixed: floating text that ends with a blank row (for example "Stand here to defend the elder") stayed in English.
Fixed: training dummy nameplates turned back to English while being hit. Shiny gear names with icons and marks are now recognised.
Fixed: a Distorted status on a nameplate turned the whole nameplate English. Single-column Lootrun boon announcements are translated as whole sentences.
Fixed: Lootrun mission names were replaced by gear with the same name. They now follow the content name setting.
Fixed: dialogue in 12 quests such as Tower of Ascension is now recognised while it is still being typed.
Fixed: after turning off "Wear my cape", the switch disappeared and the cape could not be turned back on (thanks to Hyperionml).
Capes: capes are now uploaded only at wynnchayuan.com. "Upload cape" in F6 opens your account page there and signs you in. The preview file in the capes folder is no longer read.
Update notices have a "click here to update" line (same as /wcy update), and each step of an in-game update is written to update-log.txt.
Diagnostic files are kept in config/wynnchayuan/debug and removed after two weeks. captured.json keeps a whole tooltip paragraph as one entry and notes where each line was seen.
Translations: Lootrun and Raid terms reviewed in all seven languages, floating text polished, and new lines recorded in game.

1.0.2.headline: 1.0.2: capes, leaves for everyone, a website and in-game updates
items: Capes: wear your own WynnChaYuan cape, visible to other players who have the mod. Upload it under F6 > Badge & cape; the preview can be dragged around. Anyone can upload a PNG (1 MB); GIFs and the 20 MB limit are for developers, sponsors and contributors. Capes can be up to 1056×816. Templates are in capes/templates on GitHub.

Leaves before names: gold for developers, cyan for sponsors, green for contributors, and grey for everyone else with the mod. Players with the mod see each other's, including a developer's rainbow leaf and which leaves you chose to show.
New website, wynnchayuan.com, in eight languages: a cape gallery and an account page. You can register with Discord, then type `/wcy link <code>` in game to link your game ID.

For the two features above, the mod checks in with wynnchayuan.com when you join Wynncraft (your UUID, your public profile, a public key and signature that prove the account is yours, and your cape and badge settings). No game content is sent. There is no switch for this: everyone with the mod has a leaf.
The release notes screen has an Update button: it downloads the new version and swaps it in when you close the game.
Names of quests, caves, discoveries and other content can be shown translated, translated with the original, or left in the original.
Traditional Chinese: Mythic gear now has translated names, and Shiny items have a new name.
Fixed: with WynnMod installed, the four lines of the raid summary stayed in English.
Fixed: the Lootrun section of the scoreboard was split across the wrong lines, and curses in the left column of the beacon panel stayed in English.
Fixed: effect names in the Wynntils status overlay were replaced by gear of the same name.
Fixed: with names set to translated plus original, some tome names stayed in English; Wynnventory now puts the original on its own line; names of crafted items are no longer translated.
Translations: more than three thousand new lines of quest dialogue, mob nameplates and menus recorded in game, across all languages, including Japanese by yool141.

zh_tw.headline: 1.0.2：披風、人人都有的葉子、網站與遊戲內更新
items: 披風：可以穿上自己的 WynnChaYuan 披風，其他裝了模組的玩家看得到。在 F6「徽章與披風」上傳，預覽可以拖曳旋轉。PNG 大家都能傳（1 MB）；GIF 與 20 MB 的上限給開發者、贊助者、貢獻者。披風最大可以到 1056×816。範本在 GitHub 的 capes/templates。
名字前面的葉子：開發者金色、贊助者青藍色、貢獻者綠色，其他裝了模組的玩家是灰色。裝了模組的玩家互相看得到，包含開發者的彩色模式與你選了要展示哪幾片。
新網站 wynnchayuan.com，有八種語言：披風一覽與帳號頁。可以用 Discord 註冊，再在遊戲裡輸入 `/wcy link 綁定碼` 綁定遊戲 ID。
為了上面兩項，模組在你進 Wynncraft 時會向 wynnchayuan.com 報到（你的 UUID、公開的個人檔案、用來證明帳號是本人的公鑰與簽章，以及披風與徽章的設定）。不送任何遊戲內容。這一項沒有開關：裝了模組的人都有葉子。
更新說明的畫面多一顆「直接更新」：按了就下載新版，關遊戲時自動換上。
任務、洞窟、探索點等內容的名稱，可以選譯名、譯名加原文，或保留原文。
繁體中文：Mythic 裝備有譯名了，Shiny 物品也換了新的叫法。
修正：有裝 WynnMod 時，討伐戰結算的四列留成英文。
修正：記分板的 Lootrun 那一段被切錯行，信標面板左欄的詛咒留成英文。
修正：Wynntils 狀態效果列的效果名被換成同名的裝備。
修正：物品名稱設成「譯名加原文」時，部分書卷的名稱留成英文；Wynnventory 的原文改成自己一行；玩家製作物的名字不再被翻譯。
譯文：實機收到的任務對話、怪物名牌與介面三千多條（各語言），包含 yool141 提供的日文。

items: 披风：可以穿上自己的 WynnChaYuan 披风，其他装了模组的玩家看得到。在 F6「徽章与披风」上传，预览可以拖动旋转。PNG 大家都能传（1 MB）；GIF 与 20 MB 的上限给开发者、赞助者、贡献者。披风最大可以到 1056×816。模板在 GitHub 的 capes/templates。
名字前面的叶子：开发者金色、赞助者青蓝色、贡献者绿色，其他装了模组的玩家是灰色。装了模组的玩家互相看得到，包含开发者的彩色模式与你选了要展示哪几片。
新网站 wynnchayuan.com，有八种语言：披风一览与账号页。可以用 Discord 注册，再在游戏里输入 `/wcy link 绑定码` 绑定游戏 ID。
为了上面两项，模组在你进 Wynncraft 时会向 wynnchayuan.com 报到（你的 UUID、公开的个人资料、用来证明账号是本人的公钥与签名，以及披风与徽章的设置）。不发送任何游戏内容。这一项没有开关：装了模组的人都有叶子。
更新说明的界面多一个「直接更新」：点了就下载新版，关游戏时自动换上。
任务、洞窟、探索点等内容的名称，可以选译名、译名加原文，或保留原文。
繁体中文：Mythic 装备有译名了，Shiny 物品也换了新的叫法。
修正：装了 WynnMod 时，副本结算的四行留成英文。
修正：记分板的 Lootrun 那一段被切错行，信标面板左栏的诅咒留成英文。
修正：Wynntils 状态效果栏的效果名被换成同名的装备。
修正：物品名称设成「译名加原文」时，部分书卷的名称留成英文；Wynnventory 的原文改成自己一行；玩家制作物的名字不再被翻译。
译文：实机收到的任务对话、怪物名牌与界面三千多条（各语言），包含 yool141 提供的日文。

1.0.1_1.headline: 1.0.1_1: WynnMod tooltips, item name fixes
items: WynnMod: gear tooltips redrawn by WynnMod (its "Decorate Item Tooltip" feature) are now translated too. Can be turned off under F6 > Other mods.
Fixed: after playing for a while, most often right after switching language, the names of gear, ingredients and materials all went back to English and stayed that way until the game was restarted.
Fixed: switching to a language you do not normally use loaded an old copy of its translations and missed everything added since.

Translations: about a thousand more Turkish entries; new dialogue, nameplates and messages from the Festival of the Spirits and three Fruma quests (A Journey Home, A New Beginning, The Cursed One) in all seven languages.

zh_tw.headline: 1.0.1_1：WynnMod 物品說明、物品名稱修正
items: WynnMod：它重畫的裝備說明（Decorate Item Tooltip 功能）現在也會翻成譯文。F6「模組支援」可以關掉。
修正：玩一陣子之後（切換語言之後最容易遇到），裝備、素材與材料的名稱全部變回英文，要重開遊戲才會恢復。
修正：切換到平常沒在用的語言時，載入的是很久以前的譯文，少了之後補上的內容。
譯文：土耳其文再補約一千條；靈魂節與 Fruma 三個任務（A Journey Home、A New Beginning、The Cursed One）新收的對話、名牌與訊息，七個語言都有。

zh_cn.headline: 1.0.1_1：WynnMod 物品说明、物品名称修正
items: WynnMod：它重画的装备说明（Decorate Item Tooltip 功能）现在也会翻成译文。F6「模组支持」里可以关掉。
修正：玩一阵子之后（切换语言之后最容易遇到），装备、素材与材料的名称全部变回英文，要重开游戏才会恢复。
修正：切换到平时不用的语言时，加载的是很久以前的译文，少了之后补上的内容。
译文：土耳其文再补约一千条；灵魂节与 Fruma 三个任务（A Journey Home、A New Beginning、The Cursed One）新收的对话、名牌与消息，七个语言都有。

1.0.1.headline: 1.0.1: Turkish
items: New language: Turkish, contributed by anilken. It covers everything, quest dialogue included, as well as the settings screen and the class screen. It is machine translated and has not been proofread yet.
Festival of the Spirits: the Banish the Beyond minigame is translated in Traditional and Simplified Chinese (perk and spirit cards, items, messages).
Fixed: floating labels, mob nameplates and boss bars were sometimes replaced by a piece of gear with the same name ("Return to Detlas" showed a ring in place of "Return").
Fixed: in the hint row under a dialogue (the "to continue" line), accented letters in the translation were not drawn.
Fixed: on a system set to Turkish, some checks of English text failed because of how upper and lower case are converted there.

zh_tw.headline: 1.0.1：新增土耳其文
items: 新語言：土耳其文，由 anilken 提供。所有內容含任務對話都有，設定畫面與職業選擇畫面也是。目前是機器翻譯，還沒有人工校稿。
靈魂節：小遊戲「驅逐彼界」有繁中與簡中譯文了（特長與惡靈的說明卡、道具、訊息）。
修正：漂浮字、怪物名牌與血條有時會被換成同名的裝備（「Return to Detlas」的 Return 變成一枚戒指）。
修正：對話底下的提示列（「繼續」那一行），譯文裡帶重音的字母畫不出來。
修正：系統語言設成土耳其文時，部分英文字串的大小寫比對會失準。

zh_cn.headline: 1.0.1：新增土耳其文
items: 新语言：土耳其文，由 anilken 提供。所有内容包括任务对话都有，设置界面与职业选择界面也是。目前是机器翻译，还没有人工校对。
灵魂节：小游戏「驱逐彼界」有繁中与简中译文了（特长与恶灵的说明卡、道具、消息）。
修正：漂浮文字、怪物名牌与血条有时会被换成同名的装备（「Return to Detlas」的 Return 变成一枚戒指）。
修正：对话底下的提示行（「继续」那一行），译文里带重音的字母画不出来。
修正：系统语言设成土耳其文时，部分英文字符串的大小写比对会出错。

1.0.0_1.headline: 1.0.0_1: bomb broadcasts, the Lootrun beacon panel in "Replace in place" chat, fixes
items: Bomb broadcasts are translated: the bell message, the lines shown when a bomb is thrown, the expiry notice and the thank-you line. Player names are left exactly as they are.

Chat set to "Replace in place": the Lootrun beacon panel is now translated as a whole, so its columns line up and a description wrapped over several rows reads as one sentence. The panel appears a fraction of a second after its title.
Gathering tools (pickaxes, axes, scythes, rods): names and tooltips are translated. Hold Shift to see the original name.
Festival of the Spirits: the large floating text of the entrance animation and the festival messages are translated.
Lootrun boon descriptions are reworded in Traditional and Simplified Chinese so that each one reads as a single sentence.
With item names set to "Translation + original", the original is now moved to the next line when it does not fit, also on tomes and other items whose description takes fewer rows once translated.
Fixed: in the Lootrun beacon counter of Wynntils, White, Crimson and Rainbow were replaced by gear of the same name, and Aqua and Dark Gray stayed in English.
Fixed: on Lootrun boon cards a wide gap opened between an attribute icon and the attribute name.
Fixed: with chat set to "Replace in place", centred messages sent one row at a time (such as "Challenge Completed") drifted to the left once translated.

zh_tw.headline: 1.0.0_1：炸彈廣播、就地取代的信標面板，以及幾個修正
items: 炸彈廣播翻得出來了：炸彈鈴那一則、丟出炸彈時的那幾行、到期通知與感謝那一行。玩家的名字原樣保留。
聊天設成「就地取代」時，Lootrun 的信標面板改成整塊一起翻：欄位對得齊，折成好幾列的敘述也併成一句。面板會比標題晚一點點出現。
採集工具：四種工具的名稱與說明都有譯文，按住 Shift 看原文。
靈魂節：進場動畫的漂浮大字與節慶訊息有譯文了。
Lootrun 賜福的敘述（繁中、簡中）改寫成一句讀得順的話。
物品名稱設成「譯名加原文」時，放不下的原文會折到下一行——精通書卷這類翻完行數變少的物品現在也會。
修正：Wynntils 的 Lootrun 信標計數裡，White、Crimson、Rainbow 被換成同名的裝備，Aqua 與 Dark Gray 沒有翻。
修正：Lootrun 賜福卡上，屬性圖示與屬性名之間多出一大段空白。
修正：聊天設成「就地取代」時，一列一則送來的置中訊息（例如「挑戰完成」那一塊）翻完會往左偏。

zh_cn.headline: 1.0.0_1：炸弹广播、就地替换的信标面板，以及几个修正
items: 炸弹广播翻得出来了：炸弹铃那一条、丢出炸弹时的那几行、到期通知与感谢那一行。玩家的名字原样保留。
聊天设成「就地替换」时，Lootrun 的信标面板改成整块一起翻：栏位对得齐，折成好几行的叙述也并成一句。面板会比标题晚一点点出现。
采集工具：四种工具的名称与说明都有译文，按住 Shift 看原文。
灵魂节：进场动画的漂浮大字与节日消息有译文了。
Lootrun 赐福的叙述（繁中、简中）改写成一句读得顺的话。
物品名称设成「译名加原文」时，放不下的原文会折到下一行——精通书卷这类翻完行数变少的物品现在也会。
修正：Wynntils 的 Lootrun 信标计数里，White、Crimson、Rainbow 被换成同名的装备，Aqua 与 Dark Gray 没有翻。
修正：Lootrun 赐福卡上，属性图标与属性名之间多出一大段空白。
修正：聊天设成「就地替换」时，一行一条发来的居中消息（例如「挑战完成」那一块）翻完会往左偏。

1.0.0.headline: 1.0.0: redesigned settings, scoreboard translation, reworked gear names
items: The settings screen is redesigned: categories on the left, grouped settings in the middle, a live preview on the right, and a search box. The notice, release notes, credits, box position and nametag screens follow the new look.

Opening the settings and taking a screenshot no longer take F6 / F9 by default. Open the settings from Mod Menu or by typing `/wcy`; to use a key, bind one under Controls. **If you were already using the mod, your old F6 / F9 bindings are cleared once.**
"Style colour" (the accent of the settings screen) and "Frame colour" (the frame of the in-game translation boxes) are now two separate settings.
The interface font is now Noto Sans.

New "Scoreboard" switch (World and chat): the sidebar on the right with raid objectives, lootruns, party and guild war. Sentences wrapped over several rows are translated as one sentence; the lootrun beacon panel too.
WynnMarketSearch support: type the translated name in its search panel.

Wynnventory support: its price box, reward screen, settings screen and notifications are translated too; hold Shift to see the original. The translation panel now moves out of the way of its price box.
The Items tab has a new "Other mods" group: Wynntils screens, WynnMarketSearch support, Wynnventory translation. The last two only appear when the mod is installed.
"Name + original" now also applies to ingredients and materials.
Hold Shift to see the original: now also for ingredients and materials.
Gear names reworked in all six languages (Mythics excluded): the sense is taken from the item lore, and names that did not read as an item get the item type, e.g. "Spear of Abhorrence".
56 pieces of gear that share their name with an ability or a lootrun mission now have a name of their own.
The "Automatic" mode of the translation screenshot is gone; only "Use hotkey" and "Off" remain.
The dialogue box faded out before the original text was gone.
A box whose saved position was off screen (after changing resolution) could not be seen; it is now pulled back. Choosing a "box" mode also turns the boxes on.
With item names set to "Translation + original", some items (Mythics included) did not get the original appended.
Hollow boxes appeared in translated scoreboard lines.
In quest descriptions, the colours of the two bracketed parts were swapped when the translation moved the coordinates to the front.
`captured.json` from "Export untranslated strings" records two more things: sentences that lost a colour, and translations longer than the space they had.
Added nearly two thousand translations reported by players (raids, lootruns, interface; six languages).

zh_tw.headline: 1.0.0：設定畫面全面改版、記分板翻譯、裝備名稱重新整理
items: 設定畫面全面改版：左邊分類、中間分組、右邊即時預覽，可以搜尋設定。使用須知、更新說明、貢獻者、調整面板位置、名牌進階也一起換新。
開啟設定與截圖不再預設佔用 F6／F9。設定從 Mod Menu 或輸入 `/wcy` 打開；想用按鍵請到遊戲的「按鍵設定」自己綁。**已經在用的人，原本的 F6／F9 也會被清掉一次。**
「風格顏色」（設定畫面的主題色）與「框線顏色」（遊戲裡譯文小框的框）分成兩個設定。
介面字型換成 Noto Sans。
新增「記分板」開關（世界與聊天）：畫面右邊那一欄的討伐戰目標、Lootrun、隊伍與公會戰。折成好幾列的句子會併成一句翻，Lootrun 的信標面板也是。
支援 WynnMarketSearch：搜尋面板可以直接輸入譯名。
支援 Wynnventory：價格框、獎勵畫面、設定畫面與通知也翻成譯文，按住 Shift 看原文；「另開面板」的譯文面板會讓開它的價格框。
設定的「物品」分頁多一組「模組支援」：Wynntils 介面、WynnMarketSearch 支援、Wynnventory 翻譯。後兩個有裝才出現。
「譯名加原文」也套到素材與材料。
按住 Shift 看原文：素材與材料也可以了。
裝備名稱重新整理（六個語言，Mythic 除外）：參考物品敘述挑詞義，看不出是什麼東西的加上類別，例如「憎惡之矛」「冰封護腿」。繁中的 relik 統一叫「法器」、wand 叫「魔杖」。
跟技能或 Lootrun 使命同名的 56 件裝備有了自己的名字，例如長矛 Frenzy 不再跟著技能叫「得寸進尺」。
譯文截圖的「自動」模式拿掉了，只剩「使用快捷鍵」與「關閉」。
對話小框在原文還沒消失之前就先淡掉。
小框的位置存在畫面外時看不到（換過解析度之後）；現在會拉回畫面裡。選「小框」模式時也會順手打開小框的總開關。
物品名稱設成「譯名加原文」時，部分物品（含 Mythic）沒有附上原文。
記分板的譯文裡出現方框。
任務說明裡，譯文把座標移到前面時兩個方括號的顏色對調。
「匯出未翻譯字串」的 `captured.json` 多記兩段：顏色沒對上的句子，以及譯文比原本那一格長的句子。
補上玩家回報的近兩千條譯文（討伐戰、Lootrun、介面，六個語言）。

zh_cn.headline: 1.0.0：设置界面全面改版、记分板翻译、装备名称重新整理
items: 设置界面全面改版：左边分类、中间分组、右边实时预览，可以搜索设置。使用须知、更新说明、贡献者、调整面板位置、名牌高级设置也一起换新。
打开设置与截图不再默认占用 F6／F9。设置从 Mod Menu 或输入 `/wcy` 打开；想用按键请到游戏的「按键设置」自己绑定。**已经在用的人，原本的 F6／F9 也会被清掉一次。**
「主题颜色」（设置界面的主题色）与「边框颜色」（游戏里译文小框的框）分成两个设置。
界面字体换成 Noto Sans。
新增「记分板」开关（世界与聊天）：屏幕右边那一栏的副本目标、Lootrun、队伍与公会战。折成好几行的句子会并成一句翻，Lootrun 的信标面板也是。
支持 WynnMarketSearch：搜索面板可以直接输入译名。
支持 Wynnventory：价格框、奖励界面、设置界面与通知也翻成译文，按住 Shift 看原文；「另开面板」的译文面板会让开它的价格框。
设置的「物品」分页多一组「模组支持」：Wynntils 界面、WynnMarketSearch 支持、Wynnventory 翻译。后两个装了才出现。
「译名加原文」也套用到素材与材料。
按住 Shift 看原文：素材与材料也可以了。
装备名称重新整理（六个语言，Mythic 除外）：参考物品叙述挑词义，看不出是什么东西的加上类别，例如「憎恶之矛」「冰封护腿」。繁中的 relik 统一叫「法器」、wand 叫「魔杖」。
跟技能或 Lootrun 使命同名的 56 件装备有了自己的名字，例如长矛 Frenzy 不再跟着技能叫「得寸进尺」。
译文截图的「自动」模式拿掉了，只剩「使用快捷键」与「关闭」。
对话小框在原文还没消失之前就先淡掉。
小框的位置存在屏幕外时看不到（换过分辨率之后）；现在会拉回屏幕里。选「小框」模式时也会顺手打开小框的总开关。
物品名称设成「译名加原文」时，部分物品（含 Mythic）没有附上原文。
记分板的译文里出现方框。
任务说明里，译文把坐标移到前面时两个方括号的颜色对调。
「导出未翻译字符串」的 `captured.json` 多记两段：颜色没对上的句子，以及译文比原本那一格长的句子。
补上玩家反馈的近两千条译文（副本、Lootrun、界面，六个语言）。

0.2.8_2.headline: The "Show on look" box now aims at the text, not at the entity
items: The "Show on look" box aimed at the entity's position, but floating text is drawn above it and grows upward when it has several lines. You had to look well below the text to get the box, and the top line never worked at all. It now aims at the block of text itself.

zh_tw.headline: 「注視時顯示」的小框改成瞄字，不是瞄實體
items: 小框原本瞄的是實體的位置，但浮空字是畫在實體上方的，多行還會一路往上長。於是要低頭看到字下方才跳得出小框，而最上面那一行怎麼看都跳不出來。現在瞄的是字實際畫出來的那一塊。

zh_cn.headline: 「注视时显示」的小框改成瞄字，不是瞄实体
items: 小框原本瞄的是实体的位置，但浮空字是画在实体上方的，多行还会一路往上长。于是要低头看到字下方才跳得出小框，而最上面那一行怎么看都跳不出来。现在瞄的是字实际画出来的那一块。

0.2.8_1.headline: "Show on look" now applies to floating text built from armour stands
items: When **Nametags and floating text** was set to "Show on look", floating text built from invisible armour stands - such as the raid altar hints - was still replaced in place. All three settings now apply to both code paths.

zh_tw.headline: 「注視時顯示」現在對盔甲座疊出來的浮空字也生效
items: 「名牌與漂浮字」切到「注視時顯示」時，盔甲座疊出來的浮空字（討伐戰祭壇上方那種提示）還是被就地換成中文。三段設定現在對兩條路都生效了。

zh_cn.headline: 「注视时显示」现在对盔甲架叠出来的浮空字也生效
items: 「名牌与漂浮文字」切到「注视时显示」时，盔甲架叠出来的浮空字（副本祭坛上方那种提示）还是被就地换成中文。三段设置现在对两条路都生效了。

0.2.8.headline: The /class character selection screen is now translated
items: The `/class` character selection screen is now translated: archetype names, descriptions, and the three mouse hints at the bottom.

The first archetype icon drifted off the left edge of the screen on `/class`. (Note: this is a Wynncraft-side layout issue - the mod compensates for it, and the compensation turns itself off automatically if it is ever fixed upstream.)
Archetype descriptions now describe what each tree actually does.
Quest dialogue containing numbers was mistaken for a player nameplate and never translated, for example `OS Version M-37`.
Added per-language bitmap fonts for the `/class` screen.

zh_tw.headline: /class 選職業畫面現在會翻譯了
items: `/class` 選職業畫面現在會翻譯了：三個流派的名稱、簡介，以及下方三欄的滑鼠提示。
`/class` 第一個流派圖示會往左跑出畫面。（小備註：這是 Wynncraft 本身的版面問題，模組幫它補正；官方哪天修好了，補正會自動停用。）
流派簡介改成照技能樹的實際內容描述。
帶數字的任務台詞被誤判成玩家名牌而永遠不翻，例如 `OS Version M-37`。
新增六個語言的 `/class` 專用點陣字型。

zh_cn.headline: /class 选职业界面现在会翻译了
items: `/class` 选职业界面现在会翻译了：三个流派的名称、简介，以及下方三栏的鼠标提示。
`/class` 第一个流派图标会往左跑出屏幕。（小备注：这是 Wynncraft 本身的版面问题，模组帮它补正；官方哪天修好了，补正会自动停用。）
流派简介改成照技能树的实际内容描述。
带数字的任务台词被误判成玩家名牌而永远不翻，例如 `OS Version M-37`。
新增六个语言的 `/class` 专用点阵字体。

0.2.7_1.headline: Translation files you edited yourself are no longer overwritten when the mod updates
items: Translation files you had edited yourself were replaced with the built-in ones the first time you launched a new version of the mod, even with "auto-update translations" turned off. Folders set to "local files only" are now left alone entirely, and for everyone else only files that still match what was last downloaded are replaced.

zh_tw.headline: 升級模組之後，自己改過的譯文檔不再被蓋掉
items: 自己改過的譯文檔，在裝上新版後第一次啟動時會被換成內建的那一份，就算 F6 的「自動更新翻譯」是關著的也一樣。現在設定成「只用本機檔案」的資料夾完全不會被動，其餘的也只換內容還跟上次下載時一樣的檔。

zh_cn.headline: 升级模组之后，自己改过的译文文件不再被覆盖
items: 自己改过的译文文件，在装上新版后第一次启动时会被换成内置的那一份，就算 F6 的「自动更新翻译」是关着的也一样。现在设置成「只用本机文件」的文件夹完全不会被动，其余的也只换内容还跟上次下载时一样的文件。

0.2.7.headline: Dialogue no longer switches wording halfway through typing, and the other four languages gained over two thousand entries each
items: Dialogue no longer changes its wording halfway through typing: the same line had been collected twice and translated twice (879 entries removed, plus 2029 that Korean, Russian and Spanish had been missed on - and before deleting, 1464 already-written translations were moved onto the entries the game actually sends).
Simplified Chinese: eleven dialogue lines fell back to English because the translation contained characters the dialogue font cannot draw.
Traditional Chinese: four mistranslations - two lines had their translations swapped, one Shaman ability description was wrong, a doubled character, and a missing speaker prefix.
The "Area Discovered:" line now uses the same name as the discovery list - the same place no longer has two names.
91 places where one term had two different wordings in the same language, including nine Japanese world event names that differed between the map marker and the chat announcement.

24 places where two different English terms shared one translation: Dwarf colliding with Gnome, Korean using one name for Dash, Charge and Lunge, Russian using one for Dash, Charge and Haul, and Lootrun's "Missions" reading the same as "Quest".
83 monsters whose name differed depending on which nameplate style was showing.
Raid names that were left in English mid-sentence are translated.
Tome, charm and aspect names follow F6's "translate item names" switch - hold Shift to see the English name.
172 in-game strings a community contributor had collected are now in all seven languages (they were Japanese-only).

Japanese, Korean, Russian and Spanish each gained over two thousand entries: NPC dialogue and dialogue choices outside quests, quest book and dungeon reward rows, NPC titles and interaction prompts, monster nameplates, discovery names, Lootrun and Raid cards, and cave descriptions.
Quest dialogue: Hollow Serenity and Forbidden Prison are now complete in Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Russian and Spanish.
Japanese: quest dialogue for all four Dwarves and Doguns chapters (community contribution).
Chinese: eighty-odd translations wrote the ellipsis as three ASCII dots; the frame-by-frame loading animation keeps its dots.
Ability descriptions now use the same name as the term list - a third wording made the line show a different word and lose its colour.
20 player pet nameplates removed.
Lootrun and raid floating text: ten terms that had two wordings each.
32 marketplace, crafting-station and chat strings a player brought back from the game.

zh_tw.headline: 對話不再打字打到一半改口，另外四個語言各補了兩千多條
items: 對話不再打字打到一半改口：同一句台詞被收成兩條、各翻了一次（刪掉 879 條；韓文、俄文、西文另外補刪了當初漏掉的 2029 條，刪之前把 1464 條已經寫好卻用不到的譯文搬到實機條目）。
簡體中文十一句對話因為譯文裡有對話字型畫不出來的字，整句退回英文。
繁體中文四條錯譯：兩句台詞的譯文對調、薩滿一條技能敘述整句翻錯、一處疊字、一句掉了說話者前綴。
「發現地區：」那一行的地名改成跟探索點清單一致，同一個地點不再有兩個名字。
各語言同一個詞兩種說法共 91 處，包括日文九個世界事件名在地圖標記與聊天訊息上不一樣。
兩個不同的英文詞共用一個譯名共 24 處：Dwarf 與 Gnome 撞名、韓文的 Dash／Charge／Lunge 三個技能同名、俄文的 Dash／Charge／Haul 同名、Lootrun 的 Missions 跟 Quest 都叫「任務」。
同一隻怪因為名牌樣式不同被翻成兩個名字，83 處統一。
Raid 名夾在句子中間沒翻到的幾處。
書卷、護符、面向的名稱納入 F6 的「翻譯物品名稱」開關，按住 Shift 看得到英文原名。
社群貢獻帶進來的 172 條實機條目補到全部七個語言並翻完（原本只有日文有）。
日文、韓文、俄文、西文各補兩千多條：任務外的 NPC 對話與對話選項、任務書與地城的獎勵列、NPC 稱號與互動提示、怪物名牌、探索點名稱、Lootrun 與 Raid 的卡片，以及洞窟說明。
任務對話：Hollow Serenity 與 Forbidden Prison 兩個任務補完，簡體中文、日文、韓文、俄文、西文都到 100%。
日文：Dwarves and Doguns 四個章節的任務對話（社群貢獻）。
中文的半形 `...` 改成「……」（八十幾條）；逐格的載入動畫照原樣不動。
技能敘述裡的名稱改成跟詞表一致——寫成第三種說法時，畫面上會換成另一個詞而且掉回底色。
刪掉 20 條玩家寵物的名牌。
Lootrun 與討伐戰漂浮字的十個同詞異譯。
玩家實機帶回來的 32 條市場、製作台與聊天訊息。

zh_cn.headline: 对话不再打字打到一半改口，另外四个语言各补了两千多条
items: 对话不再打字打到一半改口：同一句台词被收成两条、各翻了一次（删掉 879 条；韩文、俄文、西文另外补删了当初漏掉的 2029 条，删之前把 1464 条已经写好却用不到的译文搬到实机条目）。
简体中文十一句对话因为译文里有对话字体画不出来的字，整句退回英文。
繁体中文四条错译：两句台词的译文对调、萨满一条技能描述整句翻错、一处叠字、一句掉了说话者前缀。
「发现区域：」那一行的地名改成跟探索点列表一致，同一个地点不再有两个名字。
各语言同一个词两种说法共 91 处，包括日文九个世界事件名在地图标记与聊天消息上不一样。
两个不同的英文词共用一个译名共 24 处：Dwarf 与 Gnome 撞名、韩文的 Dash／Charge／Lunge 三个技能同名、俄文的 Dash／Charge／Haul 同名、Lootrun 的 Missions 跟 Quest 都叫「任务」。
同一只怪因为名牌样式不同被翻成两个名字，83 处统一。
Raid 名夹在句子中间没翻到的几处。
书卷、护符、面向的名称纳入 F6 的「翻译物品名称」开关，按住 Shift 看得到英文原名。
社群贡献带进来的 172 条实机条目补到全部七个语言并翻完（原本只有日文有）。
日文、韩文、俄文、西文各补两千多条：任务外的 NPC 对话与对话选项、任务书与地牢的奖励行、NPC 称号与互动提示、怪物名牌、探索点名称、Lootrun 与 Raid 的卡片，以及洞穴说明。
任务对话：Hollow Serenity 与 Forbidden Prison 两个任务补完，简体中文、日文、韩文、俄文、西文都到 100%。
日文：Dwarves and Doguns 四个章节的任务对话（社群贡献）。
中文的半角 `...` 改成「……」（八十几条）；逐帧的加载动画照原样不动。
技能描述里的名称改成跟词表一致——写成第三种说法时，画面上会换成另一个词而且掉回底色。
删掉 20 条玩家宠物的名牌。
Lootrun 与讨伐战浮动文字的十个同词异译。
玩家实机带回来的 32 条市场、制作台与聊天消息。

0.2.6.headline: Wynntils content book cards keep their layout, and ingredient tooltips line up again
items: Wynntils content book cards keep their layout: distance / length / difficulty, the reward list and the card status (Currently in progress, Can be started) are each on their own line again.
Mini-quest descriptions keep the grey the original uses on every line, wherever the text wraps.
Ingredient tooltips: stat labels start at the left edge again instead of drifting right.
Lootrun: the word "Lootrun" is one colour again - "run" no longer differs from "Loot".
Dialogue that does not fit the box moves to the small panel instead of falling back to English.
F6's Translation version row shows a date instead of a commit hash.
Tracker panel text is cached by content instead of being re-translated every frame.
Japanese: dialogue choices and a batch of quest dialogue are in.
Simplified Chinese: 395 more strings. Also 212 strings collected in-game, Lootrun boon and mission card descriptions across six languages, and The Canary Calls.

zh_tw.headline: Wynntils 內容書的卡片不再擠成一團，素材提示框的欄位也對回去了
items: Wynntils 內容書的卡片不再擠成一團：距離／長度／難度、獎勵清單、以及卡片狀態（「進行中」「可以開始」）都回到各自一行。
迷你任務說明的每一列都照原文的灰色，不會再因為折行的位置不同就變色。
素材的提示框：屬性標籤回到左緣，不再往右縮一截。
Lootrun 的「Lootrun」整個字同一個顏色，「run」不再跟「Loot」分成兩色。
對話塞不進對話框時改用小框顯示，不會整句退回英文。
F6 的「譯文版本」顯示日期，不再是一串看不懂的編號。
追蹤欄的譯文改成按內容記住，不再每一幀重算。
日文：對話選項與一批任務對話補上。
簡體中文補了 395 條；另外收進玩家實機帶回來的 212 條、Lootrun 賜福與使命卡的整段敘述（六個語言），以及 The Canary Calls 的 131 條。

zh_cn.headline: Wynntils 内容书的卡片不再叠成一团，素材提示框的栏位也对回去了
items: Wynntils 内容书的卡片不再叠成一团：距离／长度／难度、奖励清单、以及卡片状态（「进行中」「可以开始」）都回到各自一行。
迷你任务说明的每一行都照原文的灰色，不会再因为折行的位置不同就变色。
素材的提示框：属性标签回到左缘，不再往右缩一截。
Lootrun 的「Lootrun」整个字同一个颜色，「run」不再跟「Loot」分成两色。
对话塞不进对话框时改用小框显示，不会整句退回英文。
F6 的「译文版本」显示日期，不再是一串看不懂的编号。
追踪栏的译文改成按内容记住，不再每一帧重算。
日文：对话选项与一批任务对话补上。
简体中文补了 395 条；另外收进玩家实机带回来的 212 条、Lootrun 赐福与使命卡的整段叙述（六个语言），以及 The Canary Calls 的 131 条。

0.2.5.headline: Follows your game language on a fresh install, and F6 tells you if your translations are current
items: A fresh install now follows the game language properly. Korean, Japanese, Russian and Spanish players no longer get Chinese until they change the setting by hand.
The same fix stops the background sync from downloading the wrong language every launch.

F6's data page has a new Translation version row: it says whether your translations match the latest ones on GitHub, and says so plainly when it cannot reach GitHub instead of claiming you are up to date.
The tracker panel no longer repeats the Lootrun section that the scoreboard already shows.
Dialogue that only just fits no longer snaps back to English the moment the English finishes typing.
Three quest objectives that named the wrong place are fixed.
Lootrun: the block descriptions that were missing are in, and mission card rewards keep the colours the original uses.
Simplified Chinese: 1,507 strings that only existed in Traditional are translated, Mythic weapon and armour names now use the lore names, and Aspect is now 意象.
Item tooltips and Wynntils overlay text are cached by content instead of being re-translated every frame.
Long dialogue choices that scroll sideways are collected as whole sentences now, so they can finally be translated.
1,636 newly collected quest dialogue lines are translated, and 38 half-sentences that had slipped into the corpus are gone.

zh_tw.headline: 第一次安裝會跟著遊戲語言，F6 看得出譯文是不是最新的
items: 第一次安裝時「跟隨遊戲語言」終於是對的。韓文、日文、俄文、西文的玩家不會再拿到中文，也不必先去設定裡手動選一次。
同一個修正順帶治好背景同步：以前它每次啟動都在下載錯的那個語言。
F6 的資料頁多一列「譯文版本」，會講手上這份跟 GitHub 上最新的是不是同一個；連不上的時候就說連不上，不會假裝是最新的。
追蹤欄不再重複記分板已經顯示過的 Lootrun 那一段。
對話框裡剛好塞得下的譯文，不會在英文打完的那一刻整句變回英文。
三條指錯地方的任務目標修好了。
Lootrun：缺的整段敘述補上了，使命卡的獎勵照原文分色。
簡體中文：補上 1,507 條只有繁中有的譯文，Mythic 武器與防具改用背景敘述取的名字，Aspect 改譯「意象」。
物品提示與 Wynntils 疊層的譯文改成按內容記住，不再每一幀重算。
會左右捲動的長對話選項，收集端現在接得回整句了——那些選項終於有可能被翻。
新收到的 1,636 條任務對話翻完了，另外清掉 38 條混進語料的半句。

zh_cn.headline: 第一次安装会跟着游戏语言，F6 看得出译文是不是最新的
items: 第一次安装时「跟随游戏语言」终于是对的。韩语、日语、俄语、西语的玩家不会再拿到中文，也不必先去设置里手动选一次。
同一个修正顺带治好后台同步：以前它每次启动都在下载错的那个语言。
F6 的数据页多一列「译文版本」，会讲手上这份跟 GitHub 上最新的是不是同一个；连不上的时候就说连不上，不会假装是最新的。
追踪栏不再重复记分板已经显示过的 Lootrun 那一段。
对话框里刚好塞得下的译文，不会在英文打完的那一刻整句变回英文。
三条指错地方的任务目标修好了。
Lootrun：缺的整段描述补上了，使命卡的奖励按原文分色。
简体中文：补上 1,507 条只有繁中有的译文，Mythic 武器与防具改用背景描述取的名字，Aspect 改译「意象」。
物品提示与 Wynntils 叠层的译文改成按内容记住，不再每一帧重算。
会左右滚动的长对话选项，收集端现在能拼回整句了——那些选项终于有可能被翻。
新收到的 1,636 条任务对话翻完了，另外清掉 38 条混进语料的半句。

0.2.4.headline: Search takes Chinese, and text lines up better
items: The bank and inventory search box now accepts translated item names; the original English still works.
What you type into a Wynntils search box is no longer translated while you type it.
Dialogue line breaks no longer strand an opening bracket at the end of a line, or push a closing bracket or punctuation mark to the start of the next one.
A row of nameplates no longer stretches every box to the tallest one; shorter boxes keep their height and sit centred.
Switching the nameplate setting to the look-at box now works on NPCs already in front of you, instead of only on ones that reload.
Stat values whose column starts with + or - line up with the original again.

zh_tw.headline: 搜尋吃得下中文，文字也排得比較整齊
items: 銀行與背包的搜尋框吃得下物品的中文名稱，原文照樣搜得到。
在 Wynntils 的搜尋框打字時，打進去的字不再被翻成中文。
對話框斷行不再把「[」留在行尾，也不會把「]」或中文標點丟到下一行的開頭。
一排名牌不再整排拉成最高的那個；矮的框維持原本的高度並且置中。
把「名牌與漂浮字」切到「注視時小框」之後，眼前已經站著的 NPC 立刻就有小框，不用再讓它們重新載入。
詞條裡以「+」或「-」開頭的那一欄，數值回到跟原文一樣的位置。

zh_cn.headline: 搜索吃得下中文，文字也排得更整齐
items: 银行与背包的搜索框吃得下物品的中文名称，原文照样搜得到。
在 Wynntils 的搜索框打字时，打进去的字不再被翻成中文。
对话框断行不再把「[」留在行尾，也不会把「]」或中文标点丢到下一行的开头。
一排名牌不再整排拉成最高的那个；矮的框维持原本的高度并且居中。
把「名牌与浮空字」切到「注视时小窗」之后，眼前已经站着的 NPC 立刻就有小窗，不用再让它们重新加载。
词条里以「+」或「-」开头的那一列，数值回到跟原文一样的位置。

0.2.3_4.headline: Language switching takes effect right away
items: Switching language in-game now updates NPC names, floating text, boss bars and tracker markers right away, without needing /class.

zh_tw.headline: 換語言立刻生效
items: 在遊戲裡換語言之後，NPC 名稱、浮空字、Boss 血條與追蹤欄的標記會立刻跟著換，不用再 /class 一次。

zh_cn.headline: 换语言立刻生效
items: 在游戏里切换语言之后，NPC 名称、浮空字、Boss 血条与追踪栏的标记会立刻跟着换，不用再 /class 一次。

0.2.3_3.headline: Colour that keeps up with the typing
items: Item and NPC names in dialogue colour in as the line types out, instead of appearing white first
A name split across two lines is no longer half-coloured
The coloured part no longer shrinks back before re-appearing
A line whose translation has characters the font cannot draw stays in English instead of showing boxes

zh_tw.headline: 對話的強調色跟得上打字
items: 對話框裡的物品名與 NPC 名，顏色跟著字一個一個出來，不再是整句先白再上色
名字剛好斷在兩行之間時，不再只有一半上色
上色的範圍不會先縮回去再重新出現
譯文有畫不出來的字時整句留英文，不會冒出一排方框

zh_cn.headline: 对话的强调色跟得上打字
items: 对话框里的物品名与 NPC 名，颜色跟着字一个一个出现，不再是整句先白再上色
名字刚好断在两行之间时，不再只有一半上色
上色的范围不会先缩回去再重新出现
译文有画不出来的字时整句保留英文，不会冒出一排方框

0.2.3_2.headline: Two black screens and the emerald pouch colours
items: The F6 changelog screen no longer goes black
The Spanish F6 nameplate settings screen no longer goes black either
Emerald pouch amounts keep their original colours: the currency icon stays grey instead of turning orange with the number

zh_tw.headline: 兩處黑屏與錢袋的顏色
items: F6 的「更新說明」不再整片黑
西班牙文的 F6「NPC 名牌設定」也不再整片黑
綠寶石袋的數量保留原本的顏色：貨幣圖示維持灰色，不再跟著數字變橘

zh_cn.headline: 两处黑屏与钱袋的颜色
items: F6 的「更新说明」不再整片黑
西班牙文的 F6「NPC 名牌设置」也不再整片黑
绿宝石袋的数量保留原本的颜色：货币图标保持灰色，不再跟着数字变橙

0.2.3_1.headline: Search in Chinese, a boss bar switch, and a one-click update
items: Wynntils' own search boxes now match the translated text, so you can type Chinese in the content book and settings
F6 has a Boss bar switch, so the bar at the top can stay in English
The chat notice about new translations has a clickable Click here to update; the F6 row is now called Update translations to match
Altar-style floating text follows the Nameplates and floating text row, so it can be turned off
Corpus: card names for 60 world events, and the Event starting in Xh Ym line
Mini-quest descriptions read level, then what to hand in to whom, then the coordinates

Collection now measures gaps against Traditional Chinese, not your display language
Simplified Chinese: the Warrior ability tree — all five trees are done
Fixed the damage breakdown row showing the wrong label

修正伤害细项那一行显示错误的标签

0.1.4_1.headline: Simplified Chinese was showing Traditional on long lines
items: Fixed long sentences falling back to Traditional even where Simplified had a translation
Done now applies a language you picked but had not applied yet
Right-click a setting to go back to the previous option

zh_tw.headline: 簡體的長句會顯示繁體

zh_cn.headline: 简体的长句会显示繁体

0.1.4.headline: Pick a language, then apply it
items: Switching translation language now waits for Apply, and shows how many files are left

Added Japanese and Korean for the mod's own settings screen
Simplified Chinese: the Archer ability tree, and mainland wording for professions
The README now estimates how many lines there are in total, not just how many we have

zh_tw.headline: 語言選好再按套用
items: 切換譯文語言改成按過套用才換，過程中會顯示還剩幾個檔

更新說明底下的捲動提示不再壓在按鈕上

zh_cn.headline: 语言选好再按应用
items: 切换译文语言改成按过应用才换，过程中会显示还剩几个文件

0.1.3_1.headline: World event names in the tracker, and a tighter privacy filter
items: World event names in the tracker are translated — all 70 events, in every countdown format
Added the chat lines and shop-booth screens collected this week
The privacy filter now catches four kinds of message that were slipping player names through
Simplified Chinese: the Archer ability tree

zh_tw.headline: 世界事件在追蹤框裡有中文名了，個資濾網補了四類
items: 追蹤框裡的世界事件名稱翻好了——七十個活動、三種倒數格式全部補齊
補上這週收到的聊天訊息與市集攤位視窗

簡體中文：弓手技能樹

zh_cn.headline: 世界事件在追踪框里有中文名了，隐私过滤补了四类
items: 追踪框里的世界事件名称翻好了——七十个活动、三种倒计时格式全部补齐
补上这周收到的聊天消息与集市摊位界面

简体中文：弓手技能树

0.1.0.headline: 第一個對外的 Beta 版本
items: 版本號重新從 0.1.0 起算，之前的 1.x 是開發期的內部編號
新增「分享給翻譯團隊」：你玩到而模組還沒翻到的句子會送回來，整理進語料之後所有人都看得到（預設開啟，F6 可關）
分享的只有遊戲自己的英文字；不含帳號、座標，也不含公會／隊伍／喊話
修正任務完成橫幅的左中括號變成白色

0.1.1.headline: Simplified Chinese, and the settings screen now speaks your language
items: The F6 settings, credits and changelog screens are translated — English, 繁體中文 and 简体中文, following your Minecraft language
Simplified Chinese: 974 interface strings translated (tooltips, menus, ability tree, aspects, guild, trade market)
F6 → Data → Translation language switches the translations without restarting the game
Fixed: a language with partial translations fell back to English instead of Traditional Chinese
Fixed: pressing Reload dropped the fallback layer

zh_tw.headline: 簡體中文，以及設定畫面會說你的語言了
items: F6 設定、貢獻者、更新說明三個畫面都翻了——英文、繁體中文、簡體中文，跟著你的 Minecraft 語言走
簡體中文：介面字串翻好 974 條（物品說明、選單、技能樹、意象、公會、交易市場）
F6 →「資料」→「譯文語言」可以直接換譯文，不用重開遊戲
修正：某個語言只翻了一部分時，沒翻到的地方會掉成英文而不是繁體中文
修正：按「重新載入」之後墊底那一層會不見

zh_cn.headline: 简体中文，以及设置界面会说你的语言了
items: F6 设置、贡献者、更新说明三个界面都翻了——英文、繁体中文、简体中文，跟着你的 Minecraft 语言走
简体中文：界面字符串翻好 974 条(物品说明、菜单、技能树、意象、公会、交易市场)
F6 →「数据」→「译文语言」可以直接换译文，不用重开游戏
修正：某个语言只翻了一部分时，没翻到的地方会掉成英文而不是繁体中文
修正：按「重新加载」之后垫底那一层会不见

0.1.2.headline: Pick what to fall back to, and a cleaner Simplified Chinese
items: F6 → Data → Fallback language: choose what to show where a language has nothing yet — auto, the original English, or any other language
Simplified Chinese: another 704 interface strings (ability tree labels, NPC nameplates, item lore, powders)
Simplified Chinese wording cleaned of Traditional-Chinese habits; a check now guards against them
The mods list entry is bilingual

zh_tw.headline: 沒翻到的地方看什麼由你決定，簡中也清乾淨了
items: F6 →「資料」→「輔助語言」：某一種語言還沒翻到的地方要顯示什麼——自動、英文原文，或任何一種其他語言
簡體中文再翻 704 條（技能樹標籤、NPC 名牌、物品說明、粉末）
簡中用詞清掉繁中直譯的痕跡，並加了檢查擋在 CI 上
模組列表裡的介紹改成雙語

zh_cn.headline: 没翻到的地方看什么由你决定，简中也清干净了
items: F6 →「数据」→「辅助语言」：某种语言还没翻到的地方要显示什么——自动、英文原文，或任何一种其他语言

模组列表里的介绍改成双语

0.1.3.headline: The tracker says what it is tracking
items: The tracker heading now matches what is being tracked — World Event, Cave, Raid and so on, instead of always saying Quest

zh_tw.headline: 追蹤框會說清楚它在追什麼

zh_cn.headline: 追踪框会说清楚它在追什么
items: 追踪框的标题按实际追踪的东西显示——世界事件、洞窟、副本等等，不再一律写「进行中的任务」
